references.text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. This is the basis for the commandment about firstfruits that were to be brought to the Lord.
The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. Repeats the commandment about firstfruits.
Laws concerning firstfruits and how they were to be brought to the Lord as an offering.
The first of your grain, your wine, and your oil, and the first wool from your sheep, you shall give him. Confirms the priests' right to firstfruits.
Describes the ritual for bringing firstfruits to the sanctuary and the confession that was to be recited.
All who are clean in your house may eat of the gifts. A parallel provision about who may eat of the holy offerings.
Rules for who may eat of the holy offerings - only the priest's household that is clean.
The people committed themselves to bring the firstfruits of their land and trees to the house of the Lord, to the priests.
Honor the Lord with gifts from your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your produce. A call from wisdom literature to give firstfruits.
